description: Default capability for the main window. Scope is kept narrow: the save dialog (CSV/JSON export) and explicit fs permissions for writing exports and reading user-chosen targets back. User-chosen save paths are added to scope at runtime by the save() dialog, so no static blanket path is needed. The fs:scope allowlist covers only the extracted-image scratch dir — read back over the asset protocol for display and read_file-embedded into .xlsx exports. No http/shell plugin — all outbound HTTP runs in Rust.
